# Hickory Grove Christian School — After School (Extended Day)

**Provenance**

- **Compiled by:** Claude Code deep research pass (`/implement add-hickory-grove-christian`).
- **Date compiled:** 2026-08-17
- **Method:** Fetch of the official hgchristian.org **Afterschool Program** page (the primary
 source for grades, hours, and the enrichment activity list) and the **Tuition and Fees**
 page, cross-checked with the schooltuitions.org aggregator and web searches for the
 **Adventure Days** out-of-session program. All times/prices copied char-for-char.
- **School:** Hickory Grove Christian School, 7200 E. WT Harris Blvd., Charlotte, NC 28215
 (PreK–12, ministry of Hickory Grove Baptist Church).

sections.text:
- **Afterschool Program — Grades TK–5.** Held on campus, "beginning at 2:30 p.m. and ending
 at 5:30 p.m." (S1). **Latest pickup 5:30 p.m.**
- **Study Hall — Grades 6–11.** Same window (the afterschool page presents both programs
 under the single 2:30–5:30 p.m. schedule) — an older-grade supervised-homework track
 described as "a calm, focused space to complete homework, stay organized, and manage their
 workload effectively." (S1)
- **Registration / commitment.** Families complete an online registration form; space is
 limited with waiting lists available. "Tuition is billed annually and divided into equal
 payments based on the plan you select." These are **full-year programs** and are **not
 available for single-day drop-ins**. (S1)
- **Closed:** teacher workdays, holiday weeks, and summer. (S1)

**Afterschool Program (TK–5) activities (S1, char-for-char):**
- "Homework Help – Focused time with teacher support"
- "Outdoor Play – Fresh air and active time on the playground every day"
- "Reading Adventures – Creative activities that foster a love for reading"
- "Computer Lab Time – Educational games and interactive digital learning"
- Arts & Crafts
- Games Galore

**Study Hall (Grades 6–11) activities (S1, char-for-char):**
- "Snack Break – A few minutes to relax and enjoy a snack"
- "Homework Completion – Quiet, supervised time to work through assignments"
- "Quiet Reading – Independent reading to wrap up the day"
- "Friday Choice Time – A chance to unwind with activities selected by students"

**Staff contact.** Belinda Jackson, Afterschool Director — belindajackson@hgchristian.org,
704-531-4034. (S1)

sections.text:
**The recurring after-school (Afterschool TK–5) price is NOT published.** No monthly or
annual recurring dollar rate for the recurring 2:30–5:30 p.m. Afterschool program appears on
the official Afterschool Program page (S1) or the Tuition and Fees page (S2). The billing
model is stated only in general terms — "Tuition is billed annually and divided into equal
payments based on the plan you select" (S1) — with the actual amounts behind the school's
"student services fees" documents / FACTS Family Portal rather than on any public page.
**→ `aftercare-cost` Compare row and Cost Planner card = null / gap.**

**Adventure Days is a DIFFERENT program — do NOT treat its rate as the recurring aftercare
price.** Adventure Days provides child care services and activities for HGCS students in
**TK–7th grades when school is NOT in session** (i.e., out-of-session day care, not the daily
2:30–5:30 p.m. aftercare). Students must be preregistered with the afterschool department and
pay **$35.00 per day** at least one week prior to each Adventure Day. (S3)

sections.text:
- **NULL / NOT PUBLISHED (the key finding):** the recurring TK–5 Afterschool monthly/annual
 rate. Confirmed absent from both the Afterschool Program page (S1) and the Tuition and Fees
 page (S2). The `aftercare-cost` Compare row cannot be populated.
- **DO NOT CONFLATE:** Adventure Days ($35.00/day, TK–7, out-of-session) is a separate
 program from the recurring 2:30–5:30 p.m. aftercare; it is captured here only so the
 distinction is on record, and it is NOT the recurring aftercare rate.
- **UNVERIFIED against the official page (do not ingest as fact without confirmation):** an
 aggregator/search snippet (S3) surfaced Study Hall figures ($288 / 2-day, $432 / 3-day,
 $900 / 5-day per year) and a Before School figure ($270/yr, 7:00–7:30 a.m.), but tagged
 them to grades **8–12**, which **conflicts** with the official page's **6–11** Study Hall
 range and with the school's own program framing. These snippet figures are **not** on any
 official hgchristian.org page we fetched and should be treated as unconfirmed. They do not
 supply the TK–5 recurring rate in any case.
- **TO VERIFY (optional deeper pass):** the school's linked "student services fees 2026-2027"
 document (behind S2) may contain the recurring Afterschool rate; it was not directly
 retrievable in this pass. If located, it could convert this null into a real figure.
